notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, adventurers! 👋

Here comes the latest round of patches addressing some minor bugs and improvements. Thanks again for reporting these to us, you are absolutely amazing! 🙌

[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Here's a summary of what's included in patch 1.1.1:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect chapter numbers being shown in save files
[*] Fixed an issue with item interaction and the alien Keef
[*] Changed some dialog lines to more fitting ones
[*] Fixed some audio related issues
[*] Fixed some typos
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Rest assured we’re working on improvements all the time, so keep an eye out for future patches!

And please keep your feedback coming in Elroy's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1082190/discussions/0/]Steam Discussions forum[/url]! 🤝

Love,

[b]- Team Elroy[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is out!
notes.notes:
Desayák! 👋

We're humbled by the super positive response we have received since the release! 🙏

Huge thanks to everyone for playing and for sharing your impressions with us.

Meanwhile, we've been busy testing and fixing behind the scenes. ✅
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Here's a summary of what's included in patch 1.0.2:
- Fixed an issue that caused particle effects to float in air
- Fixed typos
- Fixed an interaction on Fuxia that caused an unintentionally repeatable game state
- Fixed achievements from demo to be triggered in full game
- Fixed an achievement from unintentionally triggering in credits
- Fixed some visual glitches
- Changed: game no longer pauses when out of focus while playing in windowed mode
[hr][/hr]

As always, please keep your feedback coming in Elroy's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1082190/discussions/0/]Steam Discussions forum[/url]! ❤️

Love,

[b]- Team Elroy[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082190/Elroy_and_the_Aliens/

notes.title: When Release?
notes.notes:
Hello dear friends!

The year is coming to an end and some of you might be wondering where we are with Elroy.

Well, we're extremely proud to announce that we are sailing into the holidays with the game [b]feature, story, puzzle and voice-over COMPLETE![/b]

Here is a glimpse behind the scenes featuring our [b]amazing actors recording the voices[/b] for Elroy and the Aliens. Featured in this video are 4 of our 20+ actors for Elroy's 60+ characters.

[previewyoutube=d3vEgEdzZM4;full][/previewyoutube]

In order of appearance: [b]Adam Longworth[/b] as Wanderbrust, [b]Jay Rincon[/b] as Elroy, [b]Dev Joshi[/b] as Peggie & [b]Penelope Rawlins[/b] as Nikki.

Directed by: the great [b]Mark Estdale[/b] at the OMUK studios.

[b]We'll continue in 2024 with polishing, QA-ing, translating and preparing the game for the release in Q4.[/b]

Have a wonderful holiday time! :)

We wish you all a lot of love, happiness and peace on Earth. <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/ce62f6977064440920ba2fb0ba015d3016c3c321.jpg[/img]

Sincerely, 
Team Elroy
